column1: # SIAM 100-digit SEALED HOLDOUT B, family D16: heat equation from rough data; the time t* at which a functional of u(.,t) reaches a value (see heat_functionals.m)

column4: Dirichlet [0,1], u0=1, u(1/2,t)=1/2. A: sine series (odd n, 4/(n pi)) == B: method of images (erf sum); secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.1)

Dirichlet, u0 = hat 1-|2x-1|, Int u = 1/4. A: sine series of the hat, Int term by term == B: images erf sum + tanh-sinh Int; secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.2)

Dirichlet, u0 = Haar psi, arc length 3. A: sine series of Haar psi, u_x by Clenshaw, tanh-sinh arc length == B: images (Gaussians at the jumps of the odd periodic extension); secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.3)

Dirichlet, u0 = x, arc length 2. A: sine series 2(-1)^(n+1)/(n pi), u_x by Clenshaw, tanh-sinh arc length == B: images (Gaussians + erf slope terms); secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.4)
Neumann, u0 = [x>1/3], u(0,t) = 1/3. A: cosine series 2/3 - 2 sin(n pi/3)/(n pi) == B: images with EVEN reflections; secant in log t at 70 digits, agree 71.0 digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.5)

Dirichlet [0,pi], u0 = x(pi-x), Int u^2 = 1. A: Parseval with b_n = 8/(pi n^3) == B: sine coefficients by quadrature + Int u^2 by quadrature (no closed form, no Parseval); secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.6)

u_t = u_xx + 1, Dirichlet, u0 = 0, u(1/2,t) = 1/10. A: steady state x(1-x)/2 minus the sine series 4/(n pi)^3 == B: images by tanh-sinh quadrature of kernel x data; secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.7)

u(0)=0, u_x(1)+u(1)=0, u0=1, u(1,t)=1/4. A: Robin eigenfunction series, eigenvalues tan mu = -mu by findroot == B: Talbot inversion (mpmath invertlaplace) of the closed-form Laplace transform, no eigenvalues; secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.8)

unit square, Dirichlet, u0 = 1, u(1/2,1/2,t) = 1/2. A: product U(1/2,t)^2, U the bd16.1 series == B: images for U, squared; secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.9)

Dirichlet, u0 = box [1/3,2/3), arc length 28/10. A: sine series of the box, u_x by Clenshaw, tanh-sinh arc length == B: images (Gaussians at the jumps); secant in log t at 70 digits, agree to all 66 printed digits (siam100_refs/bd16_ref.py bd16.10)
